QF.id: III-C Fraudulent and Unfair Trade Practices_25

question.text: Under the PFUTP Regulations, illegal mobilization of funds by carrying on any collective investment scheme is classified under which category?

answer.text: Manipulative, fraudulent and unfair trade practice

explanation.text: The Logic: Regulation 4(2) of the PFUTP Regulations lists illegal mobilization of funds by sponsoring, causing sponsorship of, carrying on or causing the carrying on of any collective investment scheme as a manipulative, fraudulent and unfair trade practice. The Trap: While such conduct can also attract action under the collective investment scheme registration regime and other SEBI provisions, the specific PFUTP classification is as a fraudulent or unfair trade practice. Note: Treat the PFUTP entry as the primary classification asked in this question; separate regulatory consequences (registration, penalties, etc.) can apply in parallel.
